def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive extraction of position and other relevant info
    my_pos = observation.get('agent', {}).get('position', (0, 0))
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', [])
    mode = observation.get('mode', '')

    # Helper function to get positions of entities
    def get_positions(entity_list):
        return [entity.get('position', (0, 0)) for entity in entity_list]

    # Determine current position
    x, y = my_pos

    # Decide movement based on the mode
    if 'resource_collection' in mode:
        # Move towards the closest resource
        resource_positions = get_positions(resources)
        if resource_positions:
            # Find closest resource
            target = min(resource_positions, key=lambda p: abs(p[0]-x)+abs(p[1]-y))
            dx = 1 if target[0] > x else -1 if target[0] < x else 0
            dy = 1 if target[1] > y else -1 if target[1] < y else 0
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            # No resources available, stay still
            return [0, 0]
    elif 'pursuit_evasion' in mode:
        # Pursue the closest enemy
        enemy_positions = get_positions(enemies)
        if enemy_positions:
            target = min(enemy_positions, key=lambda p: abs(p[0]-x)+abs(p[1]-y))
            dx = 1 if target[0] > x else -1 if target[0] < x else 0
            dy = 1 if target[1] > y else -1 if target[1] < y else 0
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            # No enemies, move randomly to maintain position
            return [0, 0]

        # Move towards the closest unclaimed territory

            return [dx, dy]

            # Already controlling or no territory, stay put
            return [0, 0]
    else:
        # Default behavior: stay still
        return [0, 0]
